name: core
notes: v3.0.0: instruction-surface generator system (one CONTRACT.md generates CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, with migrator, override, and a fail-closed contract-drift release gate), the full v2.9 evidence layer (byte-cap truncation fix, retrieval-skip consumer, claude-code adapter modernization, Codex tool-call extraction), native Codex marketplace support (plugins/core bundle + .agents/plugins/marketplace.json), and a retrieval-event producer (record-retrieval-event.mjs). Shipped via PR #41 across a 10-PR adversarial hardening pass. Known gap carried into the release: the retrieval-event producer is not yet wired into the retrieval ladder, so the OTel retrieval-effectiveness metrics measure nothing yet.
